title: Cap-selected amplitudes and triangle chords for honeycomb walks
main_claim: At x=(2cos(pi/8))^{-1}, macroscopic port-to-port chords in an equilateral triangle of side R (diameter >= R/100) have Z_R ≍ R^{3/4} and mean length R^{4/3+o(1)} (Thm 1.1); the two-vacuum-cap cylinder amplitude A_N = N^{1/6+o(1)} and the planar nesting partition Z_v(r) = r^{1/12+o(1)} (Thm 1.2).

issues.location: Sections 4-8 (vacuum caps, residue formula, common-twist regularity, site/repeated row moments) and Lemma 'Isolation of the ordinary trace term'
issues.description: The exact algebraic identity Lambda T^h Psi = tau(prod P/d_full)/tau(1), the collision and holomorphy analysis at a common twist, and the uniqueness of the selected root polynomial are too long to verify line by line in this pass. Spot checks all hold (V, G, S and R bracket factors, the GGVV=1 identity, the missing-mode relation, B-factor positivity, and the small-root asymptotic eps/(1+sqrt2)). This is a coverage limitation, not a located error.
issues.evidence: Checked numerically: G(z-1)G(z-2)V(z)V(z-3)=1. On the slice t=iy, |W| gives sum g(y_i-y_j) - N sum L_1(y_i). The phase derivatives of S and R give p and r=p1-p2.

coverage:
Verified numerically:
- Local R-matrix: Yang–Baxter, inversion, rank reductions R(2l)=E2E2^tP and R(3l)=E3E3^tP, and both fusion identities.
- Physical weights (x,x^2,x^2,x^2,0), the identity ab=C0(1-h)h, and h in the strip coordinate.
- Strip kernel g: Fourier symbol, int g=1/4, ||g||_1=0.2938<1/2. Inverse shift kernel transform cosh(lk)/cosh(3lk), and positivity of Re K(y-il).
- Counting constants: ||r||_1<0.295, min R=-0.0109>-0.012, tail 0.01095<0.012, 0.71*0.295<0.20945, rho mass 1, and rho=p+r*rho.
- Force convolution g'*rho=L1'. Exponent assembly -(4/alpha_r)(s^2-1/9)=1/6-2theta^2/(3pi^2), with s=2theta/(3pi) and alpha_r=8/3.

Checked by hand:
- Cylinder deficit derivation: f_N'(1)=N D_N, the endpoint limit with kappa and gamma_g, I_m~m^{3/4}, the c-margin p/(1-p)<1, E_N>0, and P_N~1/N.
- Higher-jet lemma: the normalization uses H_k, not G_k; the forcing contour; the O(1/N) log-coefficient.
- Cluster-sign depth moments, and the winding-height and indicator telescope.
- Contractible renewal bound, tip height/diameter tails (N^{2-k eps} and N^{2+4eps-k eps}), slab wall inequalities, and the planar squeeze giving Z(r)=r^{1/12}.
- Seam phase selection 2Re(i(-i)^{c0+cH}).
- Fixed-N cap-end decomposition and the pole-coefficient argument; analytic continuation from K=i to K=1.
- Slit flux lemma: phases ±8π/3 give -2, phase 2π gives -1/√2, Z_v1+Z_v2=2Z_e+2L_e.
- Chord denominator: strip missing mass, triangle cut flux, H(r)<=Cr^{-1/4}, upper and lower bounds R^{3/4}, and geometry (sqrt3R/6, sqrt3R/9).
- Numerator R^{25/12} and the centre-walk squeeze.

Not checked line by line: the algebraic residue/common-twist/repeated-moment machinery (Secs 4-8) and the counting-branch edge-root analysis in Sec 9.
sibling_notes: Family 237 siblings (Renewal, Signed-cylinder, Cylinder-amplitudes, Marked-polygon, Radial-transfer, Polynomial-vacuum, Cylinder-loop-weights, Uniform-marked-polygon) all report no_gap_found. This paper is largely self-contained: it cites no companion preprints and gets D_N~N^{-1/4}, P_N~1/N and the depth moments internally. Its exponents agree with the siblings' values (1/6, 1/12, 3/4, 4/3, and 1/6-2Theta^2/(3pi^2), matching the Signed-cylinder entry).
